 *   "System Map (English)" and "System Map (Chinese)" 2026. CC BY-SA 4.0 (facts).
 * - LRT Chinese names: zh.wikipedia 武吉班让轻轨 / 盛港輕軌 / 榜鹅轻轨 station tables,
 *   converted to simplified characters. English names: en.wikipedia line articles.
 * - Opening dates of not-yet-open stations: same Wikipedia list (CCL6 opened 12 Jul 2026;
 *   TEL Bedok South / Sungei Bedok and DTL Xilin / Sungei Bedok 26 Dec 2026).
 * - Exits and coordinates: LTA "MRT Station Exit (GEOJSON)" on data.gov.sg,
 *   d_b39d3a0871985372d7e1637193335da5, updated 2026-10-18. Contains information from
 *   LTA DataMall / data.gov.sg made available under the Singapore Open Data Licence v1.0.
 *   Station lat/lng = mean of that station's exit points (coordSource 'lta-exits');
 *   stations without exits in the dataset use the Wikipedia article coordinates
 *   (coordSource 'wikipedia'). The two agree within 320 m except Gul Circle (flagged).
 * - Exit landmarks: only where a hospital's own "getting here" page names the exit
 *   (see landmarkSource). Nothing is inferred; all other exits have no landmark.
 *
 * Exits with `part: 'LRT'|'MRT'` belong to a combined MRT/LRT station whose two parts
 * letter their exits separately (Bukit Panjang, Choa Chu Kang, Punggol).
